suppressors.name: Suppressors
suppressors.desc: Suppressed rifles. Gunfire is heard at 9 m instead of 20 m, so a fight in one room doesn't wake the whole building.

optics.name: Combat Optics
optics.desc: Better red dots and magnified sights. +8% accuracy for everyone.

plates.name: Level IV Plate Carriers
plates.desc: Heavier plates that stop rifle rounds. +25% toughness for everyone.

heartbeat_sensor.name: Heartbeat Sensor (prototype)
heartbeat_sensor.desc: Handheld sensor that picks up heartbeats through walls within 10 m. Your lead Assaulter carries it: hidden enemies show as pulsing blips before you breach.

heartbeat_sensor_2.name: Heartbeat Sensor Mk II
heartbeat_sensor_2.desc: Production model with a longer reach: 16 m, and every Assaulter carries one.

long_range_heartbeat.name: Long-Range Heartbeat Tracking
long_range_heartbeat.desc: Picks out a single heartbeat signature from far away; inspired by recent reporting about how a person was found in Iran. Finds high-value targets from the campaign map.

breaching_kit.name: Frame Charges
breaching_kit.desc: Purpose-built breaching charges. Breachers carry +1 charge and the blast stuns farther.

grappling_hook.name: Grappling Hook & Rope
grappling_hook.desc: Enter from roofs and upper floors instead of the front door.

trauma_kits.name: Advanced Trauma Kits
trauma_kits.desc: Better field care. Wounds heal 30% faster and permanent injuries are half as likely.
